:::{#def-logical-entailment}
#### Logical entailment

Propositions or predicates $P_1, \ldots, P_n$
(@def-proposition, @def-predicate)
**logically entail** a proposition or predicate $Q$
when every choice of values for their variables
that makes all of $P_1, \ldots, P_n$ true
also makes $Q$ true.
Then $Q$ is a **logical consequence**, or **deductive consequence**,
of $P_1, \ldots, P_n$.

:::
